summary: Frontend-only UI/navigation refactor tested end-to-end. Verified nav restructure (Destinasi added, Alat Perencanaan removed), homepage section ordering (Tools #01 before Featured #02), tool card images, destinations carousel + full /destinations page, WeddingWire-style user menu panel for all 3 roles (couple/vendor/admin), My Planner dashboard (/tools/dashboard) with countdown, stats, tasks, tiles, AI nudge, recommended vendors, and auth gate redirect. All 14 requested checks passed. Backend smoke (GET /api/vendors, POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/seed) all return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: MyPlannerDashboard.jsx fetches 7 endpoints on mount with Promise.all but if any single call fails the whole chain throws; consider individual catches to render partial dashboard gracefully.
DestinationsCarousel scrollBy uses magic multiplier (step*2) — fine but could be clearer with named constant.
DestinationsPage uses name.split(',')[0] for search param; works for current data but brittle if a destination name has no comma.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /api/seed-seeded demo accounts; no new seeds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shell UserMenu uses shadcn Popover with data-testid='user-menu-panel'. Role-specific CTAs: couple→user-menu-go-planner (+6 shortcuts), vendor→user-menu-go-vendor, admin→user-menu-go-admin. Dashboard countdown rendered conditionally only when daysLeft>=0; demo seed wedding_date=2026-10-20 currently shows 17 days.
